description: "Alexandria and Her Schools" by Charles Kingsley is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The work reflects on the intellectual landscape of ancient Alexandria, particularly focusing on its schools of thought, both physical and metaphysical, and how they interacted with the wider historical and cultural contexts of the time.
